H.8 data remains strong however - with loan growth +14th wk out of last 15 - fastest pace since Feb 2023, balances +8% - double their 10 yr average of 3.5%.

2122028180441588141.en_summary: BREAKING: Petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO surpasses 150,000 signatures, including Elon Musk and Ex-Uber CEO Travis Kalanick. Jensen's odds remain at 9% to return.
2122028180441588141.zh_summary: 突發：恢復黃仁勳為英偉達首席執行官的請願超過150,000個簽名，包括埃隆·馬斯克和前Uber首席執行官特拉維斯·卡蘭尼克。黃仁勳回歸的賠率仍為9%。

2122027434661060759.en_summary: Andy Jassy says the 2015 acquisition of Annapurna Labs is one of the very best acquisitions we've done at Amazon in the history of the company, if not the best. Amazon acquired the semiconductor chip design firm for ~$350 million. Jassy said Amazon’s custom silicon would be a $50 billion run rate business if it sold Amazon chips to the market (as written in the April annual letter). The portfolio of Amazon chips includes Nitro (networking), Graviton (CPU) and Trainium (AI ASIC) chips. Customer rentals of these chips through AWS hit a $25 billion run rate at last earnings.
2122027434661060759.zh_summary: 安迪·賈西說2015年收購Annapurna Labs是亞馬遜公司歷史上最好的收購之一，如果不是最好的話。亞馬遜以約3.5億美元收購了這家半導體芯片設計公司。賈西說，如果亞馬遜將自有芯片賣給市場，其定制硅片將是500億美元的運行率業務（如四月年信所述）。亞馬遜芯片組合包括Nitro（網絡）、Graviton（CPU）和Trainium（AI ASIC）芯片。通過AWS這些芯片的客戶租賃在上次業績中達到250億美元運行率。
